daily.brief: 過去約27小時內，58個帳號發出320則相關帖文。共同看淡最集中在$RDDT（10個帳號）與$INTC（9個帳號）；共同看好則以$NVDA為首。最大分歧出現在$AMZN與$SNDK，財報後多空並陳。
daily.full:
共識

今日共同看好最明顯的是$NVDA，4個帳號明確看多，相關帖文13則。@Beth_Kindig 估算 Nvidia 的 ACIE 部門營收增速高於超大規模雲端服務商，保守估計五至六個季度內可能追上。原帖 @Jason 表示今日買入一些 $GOOG 與 $NVDA，形容兩家公司有卓越領導層與產品。原帖 @StockSavvyShay 則提到 $NVDA 據報正洽談為 Nscale 的 460MW 數據中心提供逾50億美元信用擔保。原帖 防禦輪動方面，@KeithMcCullough 說 Hedgeye 將最高配置分給醫療保健 $XLV，社群亦重新加倉必需消費 $XLP。

共同看淡

$RDDT有10個帳號看淡，是今日共識最集中的空方。@ripster47 直說$RDDT是重大失望，日活躍用戶未達預期，已在約135美元平掉多頭，並形容為容易交易的100 PSYCH空頭設置。原帖 @StockSavvyShay 把$RDDT列入10月成長股重挫名單（約-41%）。原帖 $INTC有9個帳號看淡：@TrendSpider 指出自昨日收盤以來已跌約三成，為公司55年歷史上最嚴重跌幅；@garyblack00 指PC需求展望疲軟與指引問題加速科技股資金外流。原帖 原帖 另有多方提到$NOW一日抹去三個月漲幅並跌破200日均線。

分歧

$AMZN是今日被提及最多的代號之一，5個帳號看多、2個看淡。@munster_gene 認為AWS增長前景構成新敘事，五年後或至少佔收入五成；@ChrisCamillo 說昨晚積極加倉$AMZN，同時在其他地方去槓桿；@saxena_puru 則指出財報後股價大跌，但公司並未放緩AI建設。原帖 原帖 原帖 $SNDK同樣分裂（3多4淡）：@TheTranscript_ 引述Sandisk CEO指AI基礎設施客戶低估NAND需求，@ripster47 稱其為半導體中少數偏強標的並提到即將拆股，同時盤後反應名單裡仍有人把它與科技股殺跌並提。

其他值得留意

@Mr_Derivatives 指$QQQ已進入技術性調整（峯值到谷值約-10%）；@OptionsMike 關注$SPY 748.80點位。無人機／國防主題上，@ripster47 與@TrendSpider 提到$ONDS等名稱回溫。整體上，財報後個股分化大於指數單一敘事。

weekly.full:
共識

過去一週共同看好最集中的是$SOFI，7個帳號看多。@Jake__Wujastyk 指出月線蠟燭有相當恢復；@RedDogT3 說財報後形態少見，策略以跳空缺口樞紐位做多波段；@Mr_Derivatives 為$SOFI升至17.25美元喝采。原帖 原帖 原帖 $SKHY方面，@ThetaWarrior 稱業績前掃單者今早獲利了結，總利潤約406萬美元；@aleabitoreddit 強調記憶體短缺或延續至2030年與優於預期的利潤率。原帖 @WallStJesus 亦提到ETF投資者積極買入半導體下跌，涉及$SMH等。

共同看淡

共同看淡首位是$RDDT（10個帳號），與每日窗一致：日活躍用戶遜預期與成長股回撤主導論述，而非舊週的單一航空主題。$BA仍有4個帳號看淡，@Mr_Derivatives 曾指下跌約10%、創1.5年新低，@KobeissiLetter 報導第三季淨虧損並下調指引後市值損失約150億美元。原帖 原帖 另有$RBLX與高收益債$HYG進入共同看淡名單。注意：$MRVL出現在每日分歧而非本週共同看淡。

分歧

$SPY本週8多11淡；$MU與$NVDA則偏多但仍有空方聲音，有帳號提及$MU未來18個月或見1700美元目標。$TSLA13多1淡，@RedDogT3 關注387-388分層管理區間。

其他值得留意

$MA與$LMT進入共同看好前段；記憶體與半導體ETF買盤，與財報後網路／半導體殺跌並存，是本週主旋律。

今日市場重點

過去約27小時內，58個帳號發出320則相關帖文。共同看淡以$RDDT為首（10個帳號），日活躍用戶遜預期觸發平多與空頭設置討論；$INTC亦有9個帳號看淡，有帳號指自昨收跌約三成。共同看好方面$NVDA有4個帳號看多。最大分歧在$AMZN（5多2淡）與$SNDK（3多4淡）：一方強調AWS／NAND與AI基建需求，一方聚焦財報後殺跌。指數上有帳號指$QQQ進入技術性調整。週線共同看淡同樣由$RDDT領頭，$BA次之。

daily.brief: Over the past ~27 hours, 58 accounts posted 320 related items. Common bearish is led by $RDDT (10 accounts) and $INTC (9 accounts). Common bullish is led by $NVDA. Biggest splits are on $AMZN and $SNDK after earnings.
daily.full:
Consensus

Clearest common bullish today is $NVDA, with 4 accounts long and 13 related posts. @Beth_Kindig estimates Nvidia ACIE revenue growth may outpace hyperscalers and could catch up in about five to six quarters. post @Jason said he bought some $GOOG and $NVDA, citing strong leadership and products. post @StockSavvyShay noted reports that $NVDA is in talks to provide over $5B of credit support for a 460MW Nscale data center. post On rotation, @KeithMcCullough said Hedgeye put its highest equity allocation into healthcare $XLV, with the community also re-adding staples $XLP.

Common Bearish

$RDDT has 10 bearish accounts, the densest common short today. @ripster47 called it a major disappointment after daily active users missed, saying longs were covered around $135 and framing a 100 PSYCH short setup. post @StockSavvyShay listed $RDDT among October growth-stock drawdowns (about -41%). post $INTC has 9 bearish accounts: @TrendSpider said it was down about 30% from the prior close, the worst drop in the company's 55-year history; @garyblack00 pointed to soft PC demand outlook and guidance as accelerating tech outflows. post post Several also flagged $NOW wiping out three months of gains and breaking the 200-day average.

Divergence

$AMZN is among the most-mentioned names, with 5 bullish and 2 bearish accounts. @munster_gene argued AWS growth supports a new narrative, with AWS maybe at least half of revenue in five years; @ChrisCamillo said he aggressively added $AMZN while de-levering elsewhere; @saxena_puru noted the post-print drop but said AI buildout is not slowing. post post post $SNDK is also split (3 bull / 4 bear): @TheTranscript_ cited the Sandisk CEO saying AI infrastructure customers underestimated NAND needs, while @ripster47 called it one of the firmer semiconductor names and mentioned a coming split.

Other Notable

@Mr_Derivatives said $QQQ has entered a technical correction (about -10% peak to trough); @OptionsMike flagged $SPY 748.80. Defense/drone chatter also lifted names like $ONDS. Overall, post-earnings single-stock divergence mattered more than one index story.

weekly.full:
Consensus

Strongest common bullish over the week was $SOFI with 7 accounts. @Jake__Wujastyk noted solid recovery on the monthly candle; @RedDogT3 called the post-earnings pattern rare and traded the gap pivot; @Mr_Derivatives cheered $SOFI at $17.25. post post post On $SKHY, @ThetaWarrior said pre-earnings sweep buyers took profits totaling about $4.06M; @aleabitoreddit stressed memory shortage possibly lasting to 2030. post @WallStJesus also noted ETF buyers stepping into semiconductor dips including $SMH.

Common Bearish

Common bearish is led by $RDDT (10 accounts), matching the daily window: missed DAUs and growth-stock drawdowns, not a single-name aviation story. $BA remains second with 4 accounts; @Mr_Derivatives cited an about 10% drop to a 1.5-year low, and @KobeissiLetter reported a Q3 net loss, guidance cut and roughly $15B of market-cap loss. post post $RBLX and high-yield $HYG also appear on the common-bear list. Note: $MRVL shows up in the daily split, not as a weekly common bear.

Divergence

$SPY was 8 bull / 11 bear this week; $MU and $NVDA leaned bullish but still drew shorts, including a $1,700 18-month $MU target mentioned by some accounts. $TSLA was 13 bull / 1 bear, with @RedDogT3 watching $387-$388 for layered management.

Other Notable

$MA and $LMT sit in the common-bullish front ranks; memory and semiconductor ETF bids coexisted with post-print tech selling.
